name: A Demigod Trainer Christmas
source:
Ho, ho, hoes! 

Welcome, one and all, to a Very Merry Demigod Trainer Christmas! Moana is about to learn the spirit of the season, and you're welcome to come along on this magical Christmas adventure! 

This is a brief, but very interactive story set during the events of Demigod Trainer, featuring members of its cast in new and exciting scenes. Enjoy three detailed h-scenes, with several adjustable elements to change them up on replay.  And try to keep up Moana's Christmas cheer for a bonus scene at the end! 

In addition, this isn't just some standalone offshoot for Demigod Trainer: completing the Christmas Special will unlock two new costumes in the next release of the game! 

So give it a whirl, and watch our favorite Demigodess take some candy canes up her chimney, if ya catch my drift! 

[From [url=https://shagamon.itch.io/a-demigod-trainer-christmas]itch.io[/url]]
